# Path prefixes this fork is allowed to differ from umami-software/umami on.
#
# The sync-upstream workflow compares `git diff --name-only upstream/master`
# against this list after merging. Every differing path must match a prefix
# here, or the sync is aborted and an issue is opened instead of pushing.
#
# This is the "keep our changes" guarantee: it fails loudly both when one of
# our changes is lost in a merge AND when an unexpected new delta appears.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored. Matching is by prefix.
#
# MAINTENANCE RULE: every entry below must name a path that currently exists
# AND currently differs from upstream. The workflow checks both directions, so
# a stale entry — one whose file you deleted, or that upstream has since
# adopted — fails the sync with "Fork change went missing". That is intended:
# it forces this list to stay honest. If you hit it, delete the stale entry.
# Likewise, add a prefix here in the SAME commit that introduces a new
# fork-local change, or the next sync will fail on the unexpected-delta check.

# Migrations run against a pooled connection hang on Netlify; point prisma at
# the direct URL instead. Commit a41a4b894.
prisma.config.ts

# Excludes tools/** from the root pnpm workspace so pnpm-lock.yaml stays
# byte-identical to upstream.
pnpm-workspace.yaml

# Standalone SEO reporting CLI + MCP server. No coupling to the umami
# codebase; talks to the instance over the HTTP API.
tools/seo-report/

# This sync machinery itself.
.github/fork-paths.txt
.github/workflows/sync-upstream.yml

# Design docs for fork-local work.
docs/fork/
